$comment: Base parameters of the video-factcheck design system. The single source of truth for the extension UI; for the designer, an entry point for Figma variables. Update 2026-10-28: the rounded language of "soft objects, hard links" (see reviews/2026-10-28-screens.md). Synced with code 2026-10-30: v0.6 to v0.7.0 (science pairs added: the plaus block, srckind weight pills, sonar-tag). Earlier, 2026-10-29: v0.6 to v0.6.2 (the floating-dot panel, the button under the video, the busy status, the transcript feed).

brand.$comment: The "frame with a check mark" sign (v0.6, variant D): the color lives in the sign only, not the platform link #3ea6ff.

status.$comment: The "run in progress" process status (v0.6): an amber dot pulse plus an icon. Not a verdict: the strange yellow (#ffd666) is not reused, busy has its own value.

timeline.$comment: Segments of the verdict map on the player timeline (iteration 2).

radius.$comment: Rounded language: objects are pills and soft insets, links (dividers, the grid) are straight. Containers at most 16. The 50% dot is the limiting case of a pill (an object, not a container).

motion.$comment: Restraint: the panel is a working tool next to the video, motion does not compete with the player. Scale {120/160/180/280} plus pulses.

hover.$comment: one shared pace for all hovers of the panel and the button under the video

skeleton.$comment: Skeleton cards of the running phase (verdict-stream §3, iteration 2): 4 placeholders until the first verdict, an opacity .5 to .8 pulse; prefers-reduced-motion disables the pulse.

stack_bar.$comment: The "video truth bar" stack bar in the counters (v0.4): verdict shares at a glance, number labels under it. Segments use the solid timeline colors; an empty run is fully unchecked.

card_rail.$comment: The left card rail in the verdict color (v0.4); the current card is wider with the now_bg background. Skeletons draw no rail.

mini_scale.$comment: The confidence scale in a card (fix 6, aligned with the v0.6.2 code): three 18x4 segments with a 2px gap, the level colors the filled segments and the 10px label in the level color (the color is set inline on .conf).

mini_panel.$comment: The collapsed panel mode (v0.6, the floating-dot panel pattern): the same panel morphs into a dot, with the brand sign, the run pulse and an × on hover.

x.$comment: 24px is the minimum WCAG SC 2.5.8 target; hides the whole panel.

action_button.$comment: The start button in the action row under the video (v0.6, lives in the page DOM, not in the shadow): a pill like the neighboring YouTube action buttons. States: a shield icon, an N/N counter or a spinner, a "checked" check mark #2f9e4f.

header_status.$comment: Tiny server status caption under the header title (v0.4): a dot plus text.
